req_statements.R1: The system shall expose Task, Score, TaskDelta, RunRecord and Report as frozen value types whose attributes cannot be reassigned after creation.
req_statements.R2: When a domain type is constructed with invalid data, the system shall raise an InvalidDataError naming the offending field.
req_statements.R3: When a RunRecord is serialized to JSON and parsed back, the system shall produce an equal instance with identical attribute values.
req_statements.R4: When RunRecords are written as JSONL lines and read back, the system shall reconstruct every record unchanged.
req_statements.R5: The system shall not load httpx, subprocess, numpy or typer into sys.modules when quantdelta.core is imported.
req_statements.R6: The system shall not use engine or file-format vocabulary such as gguf, llama or kv cache in any name, field or error message under src/quantdelta/core/.
req_statements.R7: Each RunRecord shall carry the identity of the model or agent under test, the backend name and version, the exact command, the seed, timestamps, per-task scores for that side only, and resource metrics.
req_statements.R8: When a Report is built from RunRecords, the system shall complete without network access or disk access.
req_statements.R9: The system shall define the Scorer port so that scoring depends only on record contents and never on a concrete backend implementation.
req_statements.R10: The system shall define the Backend port with exactly the methods a runner needs to execute tasks and report resources, and no engine-specific method.
req_statements.R11: The system shall expose stable public field names for Task, Score, TaskDelta, RunRecord and Report as pinned by a snapshot test.
req_statements.R12: Every serialized RunRecord and Report shall carry a schema_version field with a stable value so old JSONL files remain readable after format changes.

T1.title: Create the src/quantdelta/core/ package skeleton: __init__.py exporting the errors only, and errors.py defining CoreError and InvalidDataError(field, reason) whose str() names the field; add tests/unit/core/test_errors.py covering attributes and message format.

T2.title: Add Task and Score to models.py per design section 3 (frozen types, unknown-field rejection, read-only MappingProxyType view on Task.payload); extend tests/unit/core/test_models.py with construction, default and rejection tables including mutation attempts.

T3.title: Add the TaskOutput and ResourceMetrics value types to models.py; extend test_models.py with their validation and immutability cases.

T4.title: Add RunRecord to models.py with cross-field validators (unique task ids, scores key set equal to task ids, finished_at >= started_at, UTC timestamps, hash/command/metric bounds); extend test_models.py accordingly.

T5.title: Add TaskDelta and Report to models.py (delta equality, ci pairing and ordering, unique delta task ids, self-contained report fields); extend test_models.py including building a Report from two RunRecords purely in memory.

T6.title: Create ports.py defining the Scorer and Backend protocols exactly as design section 3; add protocol-surface checks plus mypy-strict fake conformers to tests/unit/core/test_public_api.py.

T7.title: Create serialization.py with single-document JSON helpers for every type; add lossless round-trip tests for all seven value types to tests/unit/core/test_serialization.py.

T8.title: Extend serialization.py with to_jsonl/parse_jsonl (one document per line, blank lines skipped, malformed line raises InvalidDataError(field="<root>") carrying the 1-based line number, unsupported schema_version rejected); extend test_serialization.py with JSONL round-trip cases.

T9.title: Finalize src/quantdelta/core/__init__.py exporting the full public surface (types, ports, errors, serializers); add export-surface assertions to test_public_api.py.

T10.title: Create tests/unit/core/test_import_boundary.py: an isolated-interpreter check that importing quantdelta.core loads none of httpx, subprocess, numpy or typer, plus a source scan of src/quantdelta/core/ for gguf/llama/kv-cache vocabulary.

T11.title: Add snapshot tests to test_public_api.py pinning the public field names of all seven value types, the stable schema_version value and the protocol method surfaces.

T12.title: Write docs/decisions/core-contract-shared-core-boundary.md and docs/decisions/core-contract-data-model-pydantic.md from design sections 7-8 (Context, Decision, Consequences, Rejected); add a test in test_public_api.py asserting both decision files exist with those sections.
